title: 2021 Semeru eruption
summary: An eruption of Semeru in East Java, Indonesia, in early December 2021 was followed by search and rescue work in Lumajang district. By the fifth day, 9 December, Indonesia's disaster agency reported 43 dead and 104 injured, with 121 evacuation sites and damage to public facilities and livestock.
